export.title: Export ROM library
export.description: Choose a library and destination to copy ROMs and existing files, then write preview metadata and assets.
export.nameModeHint: Only the exported display title changes; the separate Chinese-name entry is preserved.
export.targetHint: Choose a destination outside the source library. Whole-library exports preserve platform subdirectories.
export.contents: Copies the platform ROMs and existing files, then writes preview metadata and assets.
export.libraryContents: Copies every indexed platform, ROM, and existing asset. Platforms with preview data also receive updated metadata and assets.
